doc.title: Dan Morgenstern — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Possessions left behind in Copenhagen
summary: Everything was found untouched in 1945 thanks to friends in the underground.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: One thing before we get too far away from Denmark. Did you leave all your possessions and never were able to retain anything?

The thing is – I was going to come back to that – when we came back in 1945, after the war in Europe ended, everything was just the way we left it. That was our friends, by way of the underground. Everybody had taken care of that. It was quite remarkable. We didn’t lose anything. That is another aspect of what they did.
